tools.name: load_family
tools.description: Load a .rfa family file into the model. Params: path.

tools.name: place_family_instance
tools.description: Place a family instance at x,y,z. Params: familyName (or familySymbolId), x,y,z, levelName/levelId optional.

tools.name: change_element_type
tools.description: Change an element's type. Params: elementId, typeName (or typeId).

tools.name: set_parameter
tools.description: Set a parameter on element(s). Params: elementId or elementIds, paramName, value.

tools.name: create_topography
tools.description: Create a toposolid from points. Params: points array of [x,y,z] (3+ points).

tools.name: list_phases
tools.description: List project phases (id, name). Params: none.
